name: @dudo/ui
description: Dudo presentation primitives — shared by app.dudo.work and admin.dudo.work. NO AUTHORITY (ADR 0036, 0040).
//: IT SHIPS TypeScript SOURCE, NOT A BUILD, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
`exports` points at `.tsx` because both consumers are Vite applications that
already transpile TypeScript, and a workspace link is a symlink Vite follows
into its normal pipeline. A build step here would add an artifact that can be
stale — the one failure mode a shared package must not have, because a stale
copy is exactly the divergence 0040 exists to end.
REACT IS A PEER DEPENDENCY, NOT A DEPENDENCY. Two copies of React in one page
is a broken application, not a slow one: hooks resolve against whichever copy
the importing module found, and the failure is an unmountable tree rather than
a compile error. Declaring it as a peer means the hosts supply it and npm
@tanstack/react-table IS A REAL DEPENDENCY and is the ONLY one of the six
approved libraries that belongs here. It is headless: it computes a column
model and renders nothing, so it carries no route, no request and no opinion
about who may look. Router and Query are FORBIDDEN here and check:ui-purity
enforces it — a primitive that routes or fetches has picked one of the two
